text:
HUUB needs a WordPress developer who can turn product ideas into polished features while working closely with operations and engineering to improve the experience for small business owners and advisors.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building user-facing products and feature-rich web applications. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, and I’m comfortable moving from design details through implementation and testing. That makes me a strong fit for a part-time role where quality, collaboration, and thoughtful execution matter.

What stands out to me about HUUB is the mission: helping local governments better support small businesses by making expert resources easier to access. That kind of product work requires more than just shipping code. It takes someone who can think about the user journey, understand the product goals, and build features that are clear, reliable, and easy to use. I’d enjoy contributing in that way and helping shape a better experience for both business owners and business advisors.

One project that reflects this is a booking platform for fitness studios for Pulsebox Studios. I built a white-label class booking app where each studio had its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. The result was 64 studios onboarded in 6 months, along with a 71% checkout conversion. That work required careful attention to the full experience, from product structure to checkout flow, and it taught me how important detail-oriented implementation is when a platform needs to serve multiple users cleanly.

Although my background is broader than WordPress alone, I’m highly comfortable working across front-end and back-end concerns, collaborating with teams, and translating product needs into practical features. I’d be excited to bring that experience to HUUB, contribute to your roadmap, and help build a platform that supports real entrepreneurs in meaningful ways.

If it’s helpful, I’d love to discuss how I can support HUUB part-time and grow with the team over time.
